correctness.rationale: For independent stationary binary CTMCs the conditional relaxation identity E(Z_i(t)-p_i|Z_i(0))=(Z_i(0)-p_i)e^{-lambda_i t} gives m=sum p_i, C(t)=sum v_i e^{-lambda_i t} and H(t)=sum v_i(1-2p_i)e^{-lambda_i t}; mixed-site centered terms vanish. Positive exponential weights identify lambda and v at unequal rates. At equal rates m and W=sum v determine unordered p via X^2-mX+(W-m+m^2)/2=0. With distinct rates each probability is 1/2 +/- sqrt(1/4-v_i); four signed sums collide in distinct labeled-rate assignments only when the positive square roots coincide and signs oppose, i.e. p1+p2=1 with p1 != p2. Exactly two inequivalent assignments remain. H(t0)=v(1-2p1)(e^{-lambda1 t0}-e^{-lambda2 t0}) is nonzero at each t0>0 and has opposite sign under the rival. Independently enumerated 36 rational two-time Bernoulli joint laws and rederived the third mixed moment and example; exact analytic argument covers all strictly positive rates.
residual_risks: Conclusion is population-level exact identifiability from the entire autocovariance function, not finite-data statistical estimability.
Endpoint p=0 or1, >2 sites, coincident data acquisition, and dependent/nonstationary chains excluded.

value.rationale: The exact information threshold of a natural anonymous two-patch model is a motivated structural identifiability statement. It proves exactly where covariance loses labels and gives a minimal-in-moment-order single-lag remedy; neither a parameter rewrite nor a numerical threshold without mechanism. The twofold sharp witness is essential and could guide moment design.
residual_risks: No robustness, sampling efficiency or >2-site extension is claimed.

limitations: Same single population aggregate has neither finite-sample guarantees nor noisy detection.
